Authentication.Clients_Note: SMART Backend Services clients: each provider system or EHR with its client id, the scopes it may be granted, and its public key(s) as a JWK Set, inline under Jwks or fetched from JwksUri. The sample client's private key is published in samples/sample-provider-system.private.jwk.json; it is SYNTHETIC and protects nothing. Set Enabled to false only for a local demo without tokens.

Requirements.Name: Residential substance use disorder treatment: decide within 24 hours (DHCS BHIN 24-001). Codes from the 2025 DMC-ODS billing manual.

Specialty mental health services needing prior authorization or referral (DHCS BHIN 26-030): Day Treatment Intensive and Day Rehabilitation (H2012), Therapeutic Behavioral Services (H2019), ACT and FACT (H0040), Therapeutic Foster Care (S5145). Standard: 5 business days, at most 7 calendar days; expedited: 72 hours (42 CFR 438.210(d)). CODES TO BE CONFIRMED against the 2026 SMHS billing manual, see issue 18.

PriorAuthorization.ValidateProfiles_Note: Requests are validated against the Da Vinci PAS 2.2.1 profiles after br-payer's structural checks. The package (hl7.fhir.us.davinci-pas 2.2.1) and the dependencies its manifest names are fetched from FhirPackageServer on first start into FhirPackageFolder (default: fhir-packages under the content root).
